conventions.time: All JSON times are integer microseconds, including symbolic ingestion/cutoff day labels in F22-derived recipes; no wall-clock date inference.
conventions.identity: Symbols are synthetic typed identities, not production IDs. Within a recipe repeated symbols identify the same entity. An adapter must materialize domain-tagged IDs through IdentityFactory with a synthetic private test key, never infer from display labels.
conventions.evidence: Unless explicitly missing/unknown/conflict, positive asserted edges, membership, prices, equivalence and continuation are stipulated source-backed synthetic evidence with valid references. Unspecified metadata is fixture scaffolding, not a default for real data.
conventions.scaffolding: Give each fact a unique source key/fact/evidence identity, schema/parser version1, revision1, observed_at<=ingested_at, event_sequence in source order. Revision cases override their chain keys and revisions. All ordinary facts are ingested before the query knowledge cutoff; assignments bound exactly their stated work/attempt; all omitted unrelated session facts are out of scope.
conventions.clock: Interval-fold recipes stipulate one evidenced same clock and exact bounds unless explicitly testing comparability. Arithmetic interval endpoints use UTC microsecond representation, never anonymous cross-clock alignment.
conventions.quantity: JSON integers are exact; rational strings n/d are reduced mathematical values. Money canonical Decimal uses coefficient/power-of-ten denominator and is distinct from reduced Ratio. Source precision remains metadata.
conventions.assertions: Expected fields are scoped assertions, not an entire Answer schema. Null never means zero. Refusal/reason strings are semantic draft labels requiring future adapter mapping.
conventions.execution: fixture-recipes.py materializes input and expected JSON and validates exact arithmetic workings using Python stdlib Fraction. It does not run Dendro or test product behavior. Future builder translates structured operation/input to typed fixtures without editing this author-owned oracle.
conventions.missing_expected: Open questions are excluded from claimed expectations; do not auto-fill them from implementation output.

non_claims: No review, freeze, acceptance or publication authority
